title: Submit scan request v2
description: A minimal origin observation submitted by an authenticated source; the gateway supplies trusted scope, source attribution, and acceptance time.

eventId.description: A globally unique event identifier generated at the origin and retained across retries.

correlationId.description: Connects this observation to logs and later events in the same operation.

observedAtUtc.description: The origin's UTC clock reading when it observed the identifier.

identifier.description: The external identifier observed by the origin. It need not resolve to a known item.

technology.description: The technology used to read the identifier.

value.description: The identifier exactly as normalized by the producing browser or adapter.
